name: Boardrider Backpacker & Budget Accommodation
description:
PLEASE READ THE COVID REQUIREMENTS BEFORE BOOKING WITH US

Boardrider Backpacker is a purpose-built hostel, located in the heart of Sydney's Northern Beaches. Our central location offers a wide variety of restaurants, cafes, bars, nightclubs and shops right on our doorstep. Wake up to unlimited FREE wi-fi and FREE continental breakfast, FREE surfboard use, then walk a mere 80 metres to iconic Manly Beach, recently named, 'best beach in Australia', by travellers like yourself. Enjoy organised sports events, beach games and FREE bbqs or hop on a short ferry ride to world-famous Sydney Harbour and the centre of Sydney. Later, hit our rooftop, where you can bring your own drinks and hang out with fellow backpackers. 

We're also a working hostel with our very own Job Programme to help backpackers find casual, part-time and permanent work in and around the Northern Beaches. Weekly rates are available seasonally- so you can work, have fun and save for your future travels! 

This perfect location gives you the opportunity to experience Australian beach culture at its best, while only being seven miles from the heart of the city. Whether it's surfing, shopping, or just relaxing on the beach, Manly truly has it all.

All bookings include FREE unlimited WIFI, FREE continental breakfast, as well as FREE snorkel and sports equipment hire. :)

Please Important: 

Guests under the age of 18 are not permitted to stay at Boardrider Backpacker & Budget Accommodation and there is an age restriction of 18-35 in all dormitory rooms.

International guests only in our dormitory style rooms, passport needed for check in (only people between 18-35 years are allowed in the dorms) 

Boardrider Backpacker & Budget Accommodation will not make any charges to your credit card when making an online booking. You will be required to pay the full amount at check-in. Your credit card details are obtained to secure your reservation only.

If a booking is cancelled or modified up to 3 days before date of arrival, no fee will be charged. If cancelled or modified late or in case of no show, the first night accommodation is non-refundable.

We do our best to accommodate all bookings as they are made; however we reserve the right to modify bookings, which may result in a room-type change.

Boardrider Backpacker & Budget Accommodation will not make any charges to your credit card when making an online booking. You will be required to pay the full amount at check-in. Your credit card details are obtained to secure your reservation only.

PAYMENT
A deposit equivalent to the first night’s booking tariff is payable at time of booking to confirm the reservation. Final balance is payable 24 hours prior to the arrival date. Should your balance not be received by the due date, this amount will be automatically deducted from the credit card on file.

CANCELLATION
Free cancellation period up to 48 hours prior to arrival date. Cancellations within 48 hours of the arrival date will incur a cancellation fee equivalent to the total booking tariff.
Cancellations due to exceptional circumstances will be taken into consideration.
Please note: Booking alterations include date changes, reduction in nights and reduction in guests. These fall under the same rule as a cancellation and must be amended prior to the free cancellation period.

We do our best to accommodate all bookings as they are made; however, we reserve the right to modify bookings, which may result in a room-type change.
